text:
ashwin: heads-up — importing a bunch of legacy route yamls and the console linter is spitting errors about key names. looks like older configs used `overrides:` and new schema expects `header_overrides:`.

ashwin: example: 
```yaml
route: /v1/payments
match: prefix
overrides:
  add_headers:
    x-tenant: acct-123
```

jess: are we planning to keep a compatibility layer or force users to migrate? forcing is painful for self-serve teams.

kai: i'd prefer a tiny migration in the console import step. detect old keys and map them to new keys with a non-destructive preview. show a diff and let user accept.

maria: runtime can tolerate both shapes for a while but it adds parsing branches. i'd rather keep runtime simple and push migration to the authoring layer.

ashwin: agree. question: should the linter auto-fix on save (console autofix) or only suggest and provide the quick-fix button?

jess: quick fix button is safer. auto-fix may surprise users if we reorder keys or change semantics. show changes first.

kai: +1 for preview + quick-fix. also add a CLI flag `--apply-migration` for bulk jobs.

linter-bot: lint: found deprecated key `overrides` at /routes[3]. Recommend `header_overrides`. Use `--apply-migration` to auto-rename during import.

ashwin: for tests: we need unit tests for the importer mapping, plus an end-to-end in the console playground that loads a legacy yaml and verifies the preview UI shows exact JSON patch.

maria: add an integration test to ensure runtime rejects unknown fields when `strict_schema: true` is set. default stays permissive during rollout.

kai: rollout plan: 1) console importer preview + quick-fix + CLI migrate; 2) docs + migration tool; 3) deprecation warning window in hosted API responses; 4) strict runtime validation behind a feature flag for one month; 5) flip flag.

jess: make sure the cost/rollout dashboard has a small metric: number of routes migrated per org so CS can help large customers.

ashwin: i'll sketch the importer PR. linking the draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4567 (WIP).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: import-migration-preview -> staging at 2027-06-15T18:23:00Z

ashwin: sweet. i'll add unit tests for mapping + an example-migration snippet in the console docs.

maria: can we also add a warning in the route editor when it detects deprecated keys in the pasted yaml? small banner: "Detected legacy keys — preview migration"

kai: yup. that banner should include an inline `diff` view and the `Apply migration` CTA. keep copy concise.

jess: ok. i'll capture UX copy in the PR description. thanks all :tada:
